excerpt: Pushary sends your AI coding agents' permission requests to your phone or Mac so you can approve or deny them while away. Pricing from $9.99 a month.
content:
Pushary is a control panel for AI agents. When an agent such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity CLI or Hermes stops because it needs a permission or an answer, Pushary sends the question to your phone's lock screen, your Mac's notch, Slack or a web app. You tap approve, deny or answer, the agent carries on, and every decision is saved in an audit log. Per-tool policies can approve safe steps automatically and ask you only about ones you can't undo.

Setup is a single npx command on Mac, Windows or Linux, and you pair your iPhone or Android phone by scanning a QR code. There are also Partner plans for companies that want their own users to approve what their AI agent does, through TypeScript, Python, REST and MCP.

Pushary's founder on Product Hunt is Aadil Ghani. Pushary has launched there more than once: on 24 July 2026 it finished #2 for the day with 330 upvotes and 123 comments, and its 18 September 2026 launch of the native iPhone and Android apps finished #8 with 183 upvotes and 17 comments. It has 1 Product Hunt review, rated 5 out of 5 (as of 14 October 2026).

We have not tested Pushary ourselves. This page brings together its official site and pricing page, its Product Hunt pages and the public pricing page of a comparable tool, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.platform: Mac, Windows and Linux setup; iPhone, Android and Mac apps
profile.summary_short: Approve or deny your AI agents' requests from your phone's lock screen

Pushary 'every agent, one inbox' graphic with a Fleet screen listing running agents and one that needs you
Pushary 'every decision on the record' graphic with an audit list of approved and denied agent actions

use_cases: Leaving a long Claude Code or Codex task running and approving its next step from your phone
Auto-approving safe agent actions while still being asked about deletes or deploys
Keeping an audit trail of every agent decision for a team
Letting your own product's users approve what your AI agent does (Partner plans)

fit: run coding agents on long tasks and walk away from your desk
want rules for which agent actions run on their own
need a shared record of approvals for a team or security review
not_fit: keep agents in full auto mode and never approve anything by hand
want a free tool: all plans are paid after a 3-day trial

pricing.intro: Pushary's agent plans all include the phone app and the Mac app, with a 3-day free trial. Prices are in US dollars.

plans.name: Agent
plans.detail: One person, every agent; 5,000 notifications a month; permission policies; full MCP and API access; 30-day history

plans.name: Agent Pro
plans.detail: Unlimited notifications, budgets, priority support, policy suggestions, 90-day history

plans.name: Team
plans.detail: Up to 10 members, shared audit trail with export, weekly team digest, 365-day history

plans.name: Partner Launch
plans.detail: For companies shipping an AI agent: up to 5,000 of your users and 25,000 approval requests a month

plans.name: Partner Growth
plans.detail: Up to 25,000 of your users and 100,000 approval requests a month

notes: Cancel any time and switch plans whenever, according to the pricing page. Larger Partner and Enterprise plans are also listed.

alternatives.intro: A general-purpose option that also gets alerts to your phone. Price from its own site on 14 October 2026.

items.name: ntfy
items.what: Open-source service for sending push notifications to your phone from scripts
items.difference: Sends one-way notifications you wire up yourself; Pushary is built for agents, with two-way approvals, policies and an audit trail.

pros: Works with many coding agents from one setup
Approve from lock screen, Mac notch, Slack or the web
Policies auto-approve safe steps; audit log of every decision
cons: No free plan beyond the 3-day trial
Your computer has to stay on for phone approvals to reach a running agent
The base plan caps notifications at 5,000 a month

x.none: Apart from Pushary's own account, we found no posts on X clearly about the product.

faq.a: A control panel that sends your AI agents' permission requests and questions to your phone, Mac, Slack or the web, so you can approve or deny them while away.
Agent is $9.99 a month, Agent Pro $19.99 and Team $59.99, each with a 3-day free trial. Partner plans for companies start at $99 a month.

faq.q: Which agents does Pushary work with?
faq.a: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity CLI, Hermes, Windsurf, Claude Cowork and any MCP agent, according to its site and Product Hunt page.
Its site says Pushary sends the step that needs you, not your codebase.

faq.q: How do I set it up?
faq.a: Run one npx command on Mac, Windows or Linux, connect your agents, and pair your phone by scanning a QR code.
